MEET YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD GROOMERS

Built on care, not shortcuts

Paula has owned Canine Corner since 2002. The salon moved from Bristol Street to its Lois Drive home in 2004 and has been part of the Sun Prairie community ever since.

The team’s approach is simple: treat each pet like their own, take pride in every detail and help dogs leave looking—and feeling—their best.

  • 01More than two decades of local grooming experience
  • 02Care for dogs of every breed and coat type
  • 03Flexible drop-off and pick-up options
